source_documents.title: Group Theory-Guided Orbital Symmetry Engineering of cis -Quinacridone: From Symmetry-Forbidden to Dipole-Allowed Transitions for Efficient Narrowband Emissions

reference_evidence_units.quote: the TDM of cis-QA is nearly negligible, which is far lower than that of trans-QA (3.04 D), directly verifying its forbidden lowestenergy electronic transition.
reference_evidence_units.subject: cis-QA core
reference_evidence_units.statement: The S0-S1 transition of cis-QA is symmetry-forbidden (near-zero TDM).

reference_evidence_units.quote: In summary, this work reveals that the intrinsically weak emission of cis-quinacridone originates from a symmetryforbidden lowest-energy transition, as established by quantumchemical and group-theoretical analyses.
reference_evidence_units.subject: cis-QA derivatives
reference_evidence_units.statement: Weak cis-QA emission is assigned to the symmetry-forbidden lowest transition.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The assignment rests on calculations; the measured side is the low ΦPL.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Owing to the activated symmetry-allowed radiative transitions, cis-I2A2 derivatives achieve significantly improved ΦPL of 70−99%, in stark contrast to the low ΦPL values (0.4−12%) of pristine cis-QA molecules (Table 1).
reference_evidence_units.subject: cis-I2A2 series vs cis-QA series
reference_evidence_units.statement: ΦPL 0.4% for cis-tBuQA1 vs 97% for cis-I2A2-4 (Table 1).

reference_evidence_units.quote: cisI2A2 derivatives exhibit short transient PL lifetimes (0.7−2.6 ns) and high radiative rate constants
reference_evidence_units.subject: cis-I2A2 series
reference_evidence_units.statement: Large kr for the imine derivatives.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These results reveal two complementary effects of the carbonyl-to-imine transformation: orbitalsymmetry reorganization converts the lowest-energy transition into an allowed radiative channel, while the resulting molecular framework exhibits reduced structural relaxation and vibronic coupling.
reference_evidence_units.subject: cis-I2A2 series
reference_evidence_units.statement: The imine form makes S0-S1 allowed and lowers excited-state relaxation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The strong carbonyl stretching vibration leads to pronounced geometric relaxation in the excited state, resulting in a larger reorganization energy.
reference_evidence_units.subject: cis-QA core
reference_evidence_units.statement: Carbonyl stretching gives large reorganization in cis-QA.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: ΦPL 0.4%; the paper's thesis is that the cis-QA lowest transition is symmetry-forbidden (negligible TDM), so emission is intrinsically weak.
